tabs.note: Order A, part 1 of 2. A direct action, no escalation. Daniel places a credit order for Daniel's own customer C-0004 (RM 2,000.00 available). Chloe is refused: C-0004 is not Chloe's customer. Jason schedules this order in tab 6.

Order B, decision 1 of 3. Chloe's customer C-0001 asks for 10% off 10 cartons of engine oil. It goes to Farid with the order and credit data; Farid approves. The order stays a draft: the customer's other requests follow in tabs 5 and 7, and it is placed once, in tab 7. Daniel is refused.

Order C. 12 oil filters come to RM 216.00, below the RM 300 minimum, so it goes to Farid. Farid declines and says how many to add. Chloe revises to 17 filters (RM 306.00). That meets the minimum, so no approval is needed and Chloe places it. The decline stays on record. Daniel is refused.

Stock task. A direct action, the warehouse manager's own call. The WH-A figure for NS60 batteries is 30 hours old. Azlan's count corrects it from 24 to 22 pieces and records the confirmation. Jason has no authority; Nadia has no access to stock.

Order B, decision 2 of 3. The customer now needs the engine oil today, earlier than the terms (Friday 2 October). It goes to Azlan with the stock and delivery data, without prices. Azlan approves. Jason is refused.
Order A, part 2 of 2. A direct action within the terms. Jason schedules Daniel's order DF-SO-00249 for Friday 2 October. Azlan reads the schedule. Warehouse sees no prices. Daniel is refused.

Order B, decision 3 of 3. The customer wants to pay before dispatch. It goes to Nadia with the credit and invoice data. Nadia approves. All three approvals are now recorded, so Chloe confirms and the order is placed once. Priya is refused.

may.SL-01-01: Reads every Sales customer for supervision; approves discounts up to 15% and orders below RM 300 (SP-03, SP-06). Creates no orders (SP-01).
may.SL-02-01: Works on own assigned customers only (MP-06): location, delivery, credit, prices, stock, and orders after confirming the summary on screen (SP-07). Sends discounts, small orders, same-day delivery and prepaid to the manager who decides.

may.WH-01-01: Stock, storage and deliveries; confirms stock counts (WP-03) and approves delivery-date exceptions (WP-07). No prices, credit or invoices.
may.WH-02-01: Stock, storage and deliveries; schedules deliveries within the terms (WP-10). No prices, credit or invoices.
